latestLiveMiMoEndVictory.fixtureConstraint: Test-only End arena disables ambient mob spawning after installing the dragon and crystal.

previousLiveFollowSlice.details: Follow request produced accepted decision, skill start, low-level movement, and server evidence. Not a formal client or long-term gate.

latestLiveMovement.actions: The body walked to the requested point through ordinary movement; no teleport or command was used.
latestLiveMovement.fixtureConstraint: Bounded straight safe course with an embedded GameTest player; not a rendered client or random world.

latestLiveFollow.fixtureConstraint: Bounded follow course with an embedded GameTest player; not the formal Actor/Observer gate.

latestLiveSurpriseDefense.fixtureConstraint: One visible fixture zombie; no random hostile population or Hardcore statistic.

latestLiveGoldenApple.actions: The body consumed the owned golden apple through the vanilla item-use path and passed the food-consumption integrity checks.
latestLiveGoldenApple.fixtureConstraint: Owned fixture inventory and bounded food goal; not a general inventory policy claim.

latestLiveContainerWithdrawal.fixtureConstraint: Bounded observed chest fixture; not a general storage-policy claim.

latestLiveItemCollection.actions: The body collected the observed item through the normal pickup path and the verifier checked the inventory/stat delta.
latestLiveItemCollection.fixtureConstraint: Single visible item fixture; not an arbitrary-world collection statistic.

latestLiveFoundationBootstrap.decision: Multiple START_SKILL decisions ending in build_shelter_step

latestLiveFoundationBootstrap.fixtureConstraint: Bounded visible-resource fixture and controlled night; not a random Hardcore seed or M1 statistic.

latestLiveNetherPortal.actions: The body built and lit an observed portal through normal placement/use actions and entered it; SQLite recorded both skill completions.
latestLiveNetherPortal.fixtureConstraint: Bounded portal-material fixture; no stronghold, Nether fortress, or random-seed claim.

latestLiveStrongholdPortalEntry.fixtureConstraint: Bounded release-excluded stronghold maze and portal-room fixture; no random seed, Hardcore, speedrun, or rendered-client claim.
